text:
When you look at me
+
+my eyes are keys,
+
+the wall has secrets,
+
+my fear words, poems.
+
+Only you make of my memory
+
+an entranced traveler,
+
+an unceasing fire.

translation.title: When You Look at Me…
translation.editorial_note: The omitted verb in my fear words, poems is retained; the beloved’s gaze turns memory into both fascinated motion and inexhaustible flame.
